introHtml: Camo cooling sport towels combine the rugged appeal of camouflage with high-performance cooling fabric. Ideal for outdoor work crews, hunting expos, or military appreciation events, these towels activate with water and stay cool for hours. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a durable, eye-catching look that stands out on job sites or at tailgates.
